description: List the OneHome groups your agent has shared with you. Share member e-mails and the agent's e-mail/phones are omitted unless `include_contacts: true`. For full agent / registered users, returns the GraphQL `user.groups` list. For magic-link consumer-share sessions (a single shared group), synthesizes a one-entry list from the `checkToken` session context.

include_contacts.description: Include contact details: the share's member e-mail addresses and the agent's e-mail, phone and office phone. Default false — the agent's name, office and team are always returned.

name: onehome_get_groups
title: List my OneHome agent groups
